sections.value: NOTICE OF ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF __
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN THAT, the {{natureOfMeeting}} of the above-named company will be held at {{location}}, on the {{dateMeeting}} , by ___ o'clock in the __, to transact the following business:

value:
A member entitled to attend and vote at the meeting is entitled to appoint a proxy to attend and vote in his/her stead. A proxy does not need to be a member of the company.

Dated, this {{date}} 

By the order of the board of directors

_______________  

Company secretary

Use this information to enhance the draft.

The subHeading of this template can be modified to something related to the instructions, eg 'NOTICE OF 6th ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF JAX NIGERIA LIMITED' etc.

Examples of ordinary business, 'Presentation of financial statements, directors report and auditors report', 'Re-election of retiring directors', 'Appointment of auditors and fixing their remuneration.', 'Declaration of dividend', 'Appointment of themembers of the audit committee'.

 
Examples of special business, 'Increase in share capital', 'Alteration of the company's object clause.'

Notice is usually given 21 days before the meeting.

If it is an extra-ordinary general meeting, get rid of the entire block 'ordinary business, special business, and the proxy block'

The 'heading' should be in this sequence, 'name of the company', 'RC number', 'address of company', 'email address', 'phone number'. 

The draft should be within 300-6000 words.

Use today's date to fill the date section.
